title: A traumatized Area 51 worker saw reptilian beings in a basement
summary: Jesse Michels tells of A traumatized Area 51 worker saw reptilian beings in a basement, about unspecified at Nevada test site and Area 51, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: they have a friend who worked at Area 51 or might be a friend of a friend but they met him and he was totally traumatized

plain: Jesse Michels, a podcast host, retells a story from a couple named Garrett and Nicole McNamara. According to them, they met a man who had worked at Area 51, a secret US Air Force base in the Nevada desert, or perhaps a friend of a friend, and he was deeply traumatized after seeing reptile-like beings in a basement there.
